statement: NVIDIA announced the Vera Rubin platform is ramping into full production with racks running at partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius; no RPO or backlog dollar figure was disclosed in this press release.
why: Named partners running production racks turns a launch claim into deployed capacity across both hyperscalers and neoclouds.

impact.mechanism: Full production ramp with named deployments confirms the next-generation platform is shipping, pulling rack-scale system and fabric spend with it.

evidence.excerpt: Announced the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform is ramping into full production with racks running at partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius.

confidence.basis: Stated in NVIDIA's own earnings release, a primary source; no unit volumes or dollar values attached.
